sources.entry: OpenClip - Lightweight floating action bar for macOS that turns selected text into instant actions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ganeshmshetty/openclip) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: OpenClip
summary.one_liner: OpenClip is a free, open-source floating action bar for macOS that turns selected text into instant actions like grammar fixes, summaries, translations, calculations, and custom scripts.
use_cases: Fixing grammar in a sentence without leaving the current app
Summarizing or translating selected text in place
Running quick calculations on selected numbers
Adding custom text transforms with JS, AppleScript, or shell scripts
Finding installed actions from the Clip Store
summary.what_it_does: OpenClip shows a floating action bar when text is selected on macOS. You press a shortcut (the page shows ⌥⌘C), type a few letters to find an action, extension, or quick calculation, and the result appears in place rather than in a browser tab. The page says there are 100+ actions in the Clip Store. Users can write their own actions in JavaScript, AppleScript, or shell if a needed one is missing. The page states the app is free and open source under AGPL-3.0, with no account, paywall, or telemetry.
notable: Floating action bar triggered by a keyboard shortcut (⌥⌘C) with type-to-find actions
Extensible via custom actions written in JS, AppleScript, or shell
Clip Store with 100+ actions and extensions
AGPL-3.0 open source with no account, paywall, or telemetry
caveats: macOS only; no other platforms are named on the page
Page text is mostly marketing and does not detail specific privacy or permission behavior beyond a section heading
